scope: External upstream RealLive/AVG32 audit; no CrySirror adapter integration claimed

families.name: AVG32
families.independent_vm: Scenario / System; TPC32 scenes, not Siglus VM
families.engine_api: Avg32Engine::open, tick, advance_clock, frame_rgba, input, save/load
families.native_audio_dependency: kira/cpal still compiled without desktop-player; EngineOptions.audio=false prevents device creation
families.upstream_host: game_launcher AVG32 FramebufferGame wrapper / optional avg32_player

compilation.command: cargo test --locked -p avg32 --lib --test synthetic --test nls -- --skip installed_game_cd_tracks_decode

migration_seams: GlyphSource trait and glyph coverage bitmap
native_semantics_to_preserve: native message/choice layout and FN.DAT behavior
blockers: game_fs directly wraps std::fs: capability-scoped provider needed
process-global NLS: scope per client before concurrent mixed-codec runs
audio dependency must be separated from core/compat
native software text/effects have not been extracted into CrySirror

families.name: RealLive
families.independent_vm: Machine with native bytecode, banks, call stack, long operations and savepoints
families.engine_api: Engine::open, tick(elapsed_ms), input, render -> Surface, finished

headless_options.fonts: headless defaults to true; explicitly false for font-free engine fixtures

families.native_audio_dependency: kira/cpal still compiled without desktop-player; headless audio=false prevents device creation
families.upstream_host: game_launcher RealLive FramebufferGame wrapper / optional reallive_player

compilation.command: cargo test --locked -p reallive --lib -- --skip derived_key_matches_known_key --skip game_tone_curves --skip game_dll_runs

not_counted: game integration tests guarded by REALLIVE_TEST_GAME

native_semantics_to_preserve: native textout rules and ruby/message windows
native resource and DLL-emulation failure behavior
blockers: game_fs directly wraps std::fs: capability-scoped provider and worker propagation needed
audio dependency must be separated from core/compat
font/text renderer is concrete native implementation, not shared CrySirror rendering
native software effects still belong to upstream System/graphics

conclusion: Both independent VMs already exist at the pinned upstream commit and pass the listed external tests. Neither family is vendored or registered in CrySirror. Existing upstream functionality must not be confused with completed shared-engine extraction or commercial-game compatibility.
